senses.definition: (of a woman) Homosexual, gay; preferring exclusively women as romantic or sexual partners.
examples: Lesbian fans of the show were rooting for Jane and Amanda to get together.

subsenses.definition: (of a woman, loosely) Preferring primarily women as romantic or sexual partners.

senses.definition: (of a romantic or sexual act or relationship) Between two or more women; homosexual, gay.
